tasks.short: Compile and clinically analyse monitoring and diagnostic data

steps.what: Verify patient, monitoring periods and diagnostic data completeness
Compile selected monitoring and test rows into the review view
Calculate explicit time differences and trends in selected measurements
Check compiled data and analyse clinical significance

tasks.design: Configure the native patient/time selection and trend view in the clinical record system {OTHER}. It compiles exact existing observations and performs explicit arithmetic; the nurse checks every source, repairs gaps and interprets the clinical meaning without automated diagnosis or treatment advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant observations are manually assembled across existing clinical views.
tasks.enabler_now: Native flowsheet views can align selected records and display explicit differences.
tasks.still_hard: Artifacts, units, changing interventions and clinical context can invalidate a numerical trend.
tasks.human_edge: The nurse distinguishes a measurement artifact from deterioration requiring action.
tasks.altitude: Clinical interpretation and escalation rights stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical flowsheets can align recorded observations and calculate explicit trends; this does not establish diagnostic accuracy or local time savings.

assumptions: Boundary is compilation and analysis, before treatment, record-writing or a separate clinical escalation. Actual required documentation belongs once to the documentation task in this batch; an actual send or order must be added if included. No new analysis log is invented.

Existing monitors and laboratories supply patient/episode identifier, observation code, value, unit, timestamp and status. s1 includes identity/period checks, manual entry or lookup of missing observations and excluding artifacts. No new device interface, free capture or newly structured clinical interpretation is assumed.

Test native flowsheet filters and arithmetic before code. s2 removes explicit row collation and s3 repeated time/difference calculations only. s4 retains full source/units/context checks, manual recompilation and calculation fallback. More repair than s1/s4 allow lowers the estimate. Already automatic system compilation has no manual baseline and earns no saving.
Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates; no autonomous alert, diagnosis or treatment decision is proposed.
unknowns: Current manual compilation versus existing automatic trends
Unit/time compatibility and manual repair rates
research_questions: Can the native view expose corrected and missing observations?
Time manual row collation separately from clinical interpretation

already_counted.description: Verify/capture sources, check every compiled value and repair incompatible data before clinical interpretation.

incremental.description: Maintain clinical view mappings and test units/timestamps after system changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 20 collation and 15 arithmetic points less 1.5 upkeep. Conservative mixed-device episode has incompatible units and gaps, leaving only four standard collation points and two supported time/difference points reusable: 4.5 net. Clinical analysis stays fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess pain and sedation needs and record the actual assessment

steps.what: Review current analgesia, sedation and recent observations
Assess the patient's pain and observed sedation state
Determine pain levels and sedation requirements within clinical authority
Enter and check the existing pain and sedation assessment record

tasks.design: Configure a native view of current medication and recent observations in the clinical system {OTHER}. The nurse performs the bedside assessment, decides the rating and requirements, and enters the actual flowsheet assessment; no model scores pain or recommends sedation.
tasks.previous_blocker: A small amount of navigation separates medication context from recent observations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native clinical views may expose those existing fields together.
tasks.still_hard: Nonverbal pain, agitation and sedation effects require bedside clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The nurse interprets the patient's state and recognises when a score is misleading.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native record views can shorten context navigation; bedside pain and sedation judgement and original assessment entry remain with the nurse.

assumptions: Boundary includes context review, bedside assessment and its actual structured pain/sedation record used by the care team. It does not include administering a drug, prescribing, pump changes or a separate escalation; each actual action needs its own priced and approved step if added.

Existing clinical staff records supply current drug, dose, timing and observed scores; s1 verifies these and manually traces missing context. s2-s3 produce the nurse's assessment value, scale, timestamp and findings, which s4 manually enters and checks. No extra structured capture producer is assumed.

Native view first. Only 0.6 navigation point disappears from s1; 14.4 points of medication/observation reading and exception checking remain. s4 retains all original entry, verification and ordinary saving with no self-gate or saving.
This structured assessment entry is counted here once; the separate narrative history task does not repeat it. Shares and upkeep are provisional estimates.
unknowns: Whether the native context view already exists
Actual assessment-entry fields and escalation duties
research_questions: Can a combined view preserve timestamps and medication status clearly?

already_counted.description: Context verification and original assessment entry/checking, including ordinary save.

incremental.description: Check context-view links after record-field changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 0.6 navigation point less 0.3 upkeep. Conservative changed medication chart leaves only 0.4 point of direct observation lookup reusable and requires manual tracing of the rest: 0.1 net. Assessment and recording retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on and record a revised treatment plan

steps.what: Review assessment data and the existing treatment plan
Collaborate with health professionals to develop or revise treatment plans
Write the nurse's existing treatment-plan revision entry

loop.purpose: Phrase the nurse's documentation of team-decided changes
loop.input: Verified team decisions, attribution, unchanged plan and assigned nursing actions
loop.output: Draft nursing revision without new treatment instructions
loop.check: Nurse checks every action, actor, timing, negation, omission and clinical meaning against actual team decisions
loop.stop: Unclear decision or two failed revisions returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use existing plan fields first; residual team-decision narrative varies

steps.what: Check and save the actual nursing treatment-plan revision

tasks.design: Retain clinical review and multidisciplinary collaboration, then use the native plan structure in {OTHER} before a bounded loop assists wording of the nurse's actual revision entry. The nurse checks and saves that entry; this does not prescribe, activate treatment orders or send a new instruction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Documenting decisions after discussion requires careful variable wording.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can preserve explicit team decisions in the existing entry format.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting needs, uncertain findings and treatment trade-offs need accountable clinicians.
tasks.human_edge: The nurse contributes bedside knowledge and checks that the plan can actually be delivered.
tasks.altitude: The nurse retains the same clinical contribution and documentation responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting may phrase verified clinical team decisions; it does not decide or authorise treatment changes.

assumptions: Boundary includes the nurse's preparation, actual team discussion and existing nursing plan revision read by the care team. Other clinicians' participation is not counted as nurse effort or credited saved. Formal medication orders, treatment activation or separate messages are distinct actions and must be added if included.

s1 includes evidence retrieval and manual clarification. s2 produces actual agreed changes, decision-maker attribution, nursing actions and timing; s3 includes manual capture/clarification of these decisions. No new recording, transcript or free decision extraction is assumed.

Native plan fields first. Only three points of s3 wording disappear; 17 remain for authoring, source checks and repairs. s4 retains full clinical meaning/omission checking, corrections and ordinary same-system saving. It is an author's internal record update with no self-approval gate and no save saving.

The nursing revision records decided care; it is not a substitute for the authorised prescriber's own orders. Extra clarification/repair beyond retained time lowers the estimate. Shares and upkeep are model estimates.
unknowns: Whether local workflow requires a separate order or message
research_questions: Does the draft preserve who decided each change and avoid inventing an order?
Time documentation separately from multidisciplinary discussion

already_counted.description: Decision capture, wording/source repair, full clinical review and ordinary record save.

incremental.description: Maintain nursing revision drafting constraints and test omission/attribution cases.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes three wording points less 0.8 upkeep. Conservative contested plan revision needs almost entirely manual qualification and attribution, leaving one point of settled nursing-action wording reusable: 0.2 net. Collaboration and ordinary saving retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document medical history and assessment findings accurately

steps.what: Obtain and verify the actual history and assessment facts
Write the history and assessment narrative

loop.purpose: Phrase nurse-verified history and findings in the existing note format
loop.input: Verified facts with source, timing, uncertainty and negations
loop.output: Draft narrative with no new clinical findings
loop.check: Nurse compares all statements to verified facts and checks omissions, negation, chronology, attribution and unsupported diagnoses
loop.stop: Missing evidence or two failed revisions returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native headings and fixed fields first; variable clinical narrative remains

steps.what: Enter the note's required structured assessment and history fields
Check the complete clinical note and save the original record

tasks.design: Use native clinical-note headings in {OTHER}, then a bounded loop only for wording nurse-verified history and assessment facts. Keep source collection, required structured fields and complete meaning checking with the nurse; ordinary original-record saving has no separate gate or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical facts need careful narrative organisation and attribution.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded source-based draft may reduce a small part of wording work.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting histories, uncertain findings and omission risks need clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The nurse recognises when a plausible narrative misrepresents the patient.
tasks.altitude: Clinical authorship and record responsibility stay with the nurse.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound drafting can help organise verified clinical facts, with full clinician meaning checks; no local saving is measured.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual history/assessment narrative used by the care team, excluding the separately counted structured pain/sedation entry and treatment-plan revision in this batch. No clinical collection or entry is claimed twice.

s1 includes obtaining, manually capturing and verifying patient identifier, episode, event times, source attribution, history facts, assessment findings and uncertainty. The draft uses these actual working facts, not a new recording or assumed transcript. Missing facts are clarified manually within retained s1-s2 time.

Native note structures first. Seven points of s2 wording disappear; 28 remain for authoring, fact/meaning checks and repair. s3 retains all original structured entry, and s4 all complete-note checking, omissions/negation review, corrections and ordinary saving. More repair lowers the estimate.

s4 is an ordinary author's internal clinical record save, with no separate self-approval or saving. No order, referral or external record send is proposed; add any actual dispatch separately. Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Permitted clinical drafting environment and repair burden
research_questions: Can every draft statement be traced to the nurse's verified fact?
Test conflicting family history, negative findings and uncertain timing

already_counted.description: Source collection/capture, narrative repair, original structured entry and complete clinical-note review/save.

incremental.description: Maintain clinical drafting constraints and audit omission/negation cases after updates.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes seven narrative-wording points less one upkeep. Conservative complex transferred history with conflicting attribution needs nearly all manual wording, leaving only 1.2 points of settled factual prose reusable: 0.2 net. Source collection, structured entry and ordinary saving retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A bedside nurse retaining all clinical judgement, collaboration and original record responsibility, with limited support for explicit data compilation and verified narrative wording.
skills_to_grow: Check units, timestamps and artifacts in compiled views
Verify clinical narrative negation and attribution
Keep record saving distinct from treatment orders and actual dispatches
role.ambitious_version: Reduce demonstrated repetitive compilation and wording while protecting bedside assessment and accountable clinical decisions.
